group_assessment.weighting: The Chang laboratory (National Cheng Kung University, from the affiliations), the source of most WOX1 stress-signalling papers. Primary for WWOX behaviour in leukaemia T-cell lines under a pharmacological stress; not a Wwox-null, neurological or metabolic group. Blots, counts and confocal images weighed above the switch model of Figure 7C.

entries.proposition: The stimulus is micromolar phorbol ester, a pharmacological dose far above the nanomolar range the paper itself says drives differentiation; the readouts are DNA fragmentation and sub-G1 content.
entries.snippet: Both cells were exposed to PMA (2.5-40 µM) for 24 hours, followed by determining the extent of cell death by DNA fragmentation assays and cell cycle analyses.
entries.anchor: Results, Jurkat is sensitive to PMA-induced apoptosis, but less differentiated Molt-4 is refractory

experimental_context.genotype: no Wwox allele altered; transient dominant-negative WOX1 and siRNA knockdown in Jurkat
experimental_context.treatment: phorbol myristate acetate 2.5-40 uM, U0126 30 uM

entries.proposition: The MEK1/WOX1 behaviour is specific to one line: no other tested line responds to PMA and U0126 as Jurkat does, and the paper reports the death as lacking phosphatidylserine exposure, shrinkage and blebbing.
entries.snippet: Together, none of the tested cells act similarly as that in Jurkat T cells in response to U0126 and PMA.
entries.anchor: Results, Induction of Molt-4 differentiation restores their sensitivity to PMA-induced apoptosis

entries.proposition: The complex between endogenous WOX1 and MEK1 is shown by one co-immunoprecipitation series in Jurkat cells with PMA at 10 micromolar, with a non-immune serum control shown for MEK1 only.
entries.snippet: In resting Jurkat cells, endogenous WOX1 physically interacted with MEK1, and that PMA rapidly dissociated the binding in 10 minutes (Fig. 4A).
entries.anchor: Results, WOX1 physically interacts with MEK1, and PMA rapidly dissociates the WOX1/MEK1 complex in Jurkat but not in Molt-4 cells

entries.proposition: The WOX1 mitochondrial relocation is a confocal co-localisation with a mitochondrial dye at three time points in one line, described by colour overlap; no co-localisation coefficient or fractionation is given.
entries.snippet: Confocal microscopy analysis revealed that PMA rapidly induced relocation of WOX1 to the mitochondria approximately within 30 minutes (see the yellow punctate; Fig. 6C).
entries.anchor: Results, MEK1 and WOX1 co-localize in part in the lysosome, and PMA induces relocation

entries.proposition: The knockdown arm is an siRNA in Jurkat cells (n = 3) read as abolishing the protection by U0126; the protection P values are 0.0042 control, 0.0436 mock, 0.0465 scramble and 0.4403 WOX1 siRNA, so the conclusion rests on a difference between a significant and a non-significant comparison.
entries.snippet: In parallel, knockdown of WOX1 expression by small interfering RNA (WOX1si) abolished U0126-mediated protection of Jurkat cells from PMA-induced apoptosis (Fig. 5E).
entries.anchor: Results, Dominant negative WOX1 suppresses PMA-induced cell death
